Description: Aberdeen is a northern Chesapeake Bay city in Harford County built around Aberdeen Proving Ground (APG), the U.S. Army's premier testing installation and headquarters for CECOM, DEVCOM, and the Army's C5ISR technology cluster. Retirees get exceptional defense-industry ties, immediate access to VA medical care across the Susquehanna River at the Perry Point VA Medical Center (~6 mi), Walmart access, and MARC commuter rail connections along the Northeast Corridor. Tradeoffs include an elevated crime index driven by both violent and property crime, Maryland's higher overall tax and living costs, typical home values around $363k, and no local Costco (closest is White Marsh).
